title: How To Two Step Dance - Basic 2 Step

steps_taught.name: Basic Two Step
steps_taught.description: A basic step involving walking in a straight line with a specific rhythm.

what_works: The teacher breaks down the steps clearly and explains the mechanics of the dance.
what_hinders: The video is a bit repetitive and could be more concise.

quotes.text: In all dances all the time, you're going to start with your left foot first.
We're going to be walking two quicks and two slows.
There's a change of speed of our feet, but there's not going to be a change of speed of our body.
That's like driving on the wrong side of the street.
What you can feel is my body progressing.

evidence_segments.observation: The teacher explains the basic step of the two-step dance.

The teacher explains the dance position.

The teacher provides tips for the ladies.

extraction.distinctive_method: The teacher emphasizes the importance of body connection over footwork, explaining that the follower should feel the leader's body movement rather than just following the steps.
